The Mini-Turbo statistic determines the duration of the boosts from Mini-Turbos, Charge Jumps, Rail Jumps and Wall Jumps.
These boosts have three tiers that are highlighted with different colours when charging: Normal (blue), Super (orange) and Ultra (rainbow). The tier you get depends on how much time the vehicle has been charging the boost. Higher tier boosts last longer.

Charge Jumps, Rail Jumps and Wall Jumps share the same duration for the same tier, while the duration of Mini-Turbos is indipendent for the second and third tier.
🏅 The competitive and speedrunning communities often use the following abbrevations: MT (Mini-Turbo), CJ (Charge Jump), RJ (Rail Jump), WJ (Wall Jump), S- (Super), U- (Ultra).
NOTE: Rail Jumps and Wall Jumps have the same duration as Charge Jumps.
